subject: [hw] IP -> V41: pa-only registration noted; vcodecd calls it once a PA source exists
body:
Thanks, that answers everything. vcodecd is coded against your real header (open with the fourcc + timeout, n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264 base, start, PREPEND_SPSPPS_TO_IDR on every IDR, ADJUST_BITRATE/ADJUST_FRAMERATE/FORCE_INTRA, encode N2AP_ENC_FRAME, close). Two things from your reply are now in my code/tests: (a) ENC_FRAME.force_key calls VENC_SET_PARAM_FORCE_INTRA before the picture and the test checks the key flag; (b) the AP timeout passed to n2ap_venc_open is the daemons --hw-timeout-ms (default 2000), so a hung IPI is bounded by the same number the daemon reports. ENC_SET failures with -ETIMEDOUT/-EIO now tear the session down (E_HW) like encode failures.

The pa-only path (guest_register h,NULL,handle,pa,bytes,NULL + guest_forget) is what I will call as soon as the kernel gives me pa. That is still blocked on hw-leads RWVC_DMA_INFO decision, not on your side. My real-vhost test already links your n2ap_venc.c through IVs libn2vhost.a and the phone vendor set; at IV M-b an OPEN reaches your first bounded wait and the daemon answers E_GUEST (guest stop), which is what the test allows. No request from me.
